name: Comic Con Arabia
blurb: Saudi Arabia's largest pop-culture event, alternating between Jeddah and Riyadh with cosplay, esports and Hollywood guests.
notes: Official homepage carries no date announcement for a 2026 edition — it is a bare gallery/landing page showing only past Jeddah 2022/2023 and a Riyadh gallery, no JSON-LD event and no visible date text. WebSearch results about a 'November' Comic Con Arabia Jeddah date turned out, on WebFetch of the source articles, to describe the past Nov 30-Dec 2 2023 and Nov 28-29 2024 editions, not 2026; a trip.com listing shows the most recent edition was Dec 1 2025 in Jeddah, before this window starts. Batch note says the 5th (2026) edition, expected around November, alternating to Riyadh, has no confirmed dates yet — left editions empty rather than guess. Cover uses the brand logo (logo:0) since the site has no key-art banner and its hero images are crowd/gallery photos of past editions, which RESEARCH.md says to avoid.
